data.body:
Live-run finding + design pivot (2026-08-14).

Ran the first live-Cloud draft against REB+DIG on an isolated S3 store copy. The first scenario FAILED at the read-only preview step (no production impact): the harness seeded dummy project keys (REBEMPTY, REBGHOST) that exist only in the mapping, never in Jira. Real Jira parse-errors on a non-existent key ('the value "rebempty" does not exist for the field "project"'), acli exits 1, and the inbound fetcher (_build_snapshot, no per-project try/except) propagates that and aborts the whole pass. The stateful fake transport all other stories use returned empty for unknown projects, masking this. Reproduced read-only: 'project = REBEMPTY' errors; 'project = REB' with an impossible filter returns []. Engine review found NO contract that a mapped-but-absent project should be tolerated — the inbound search is deliberately fail-closed (correct for a bridge).

Root cause: harness design flaw (not a product bug) — the plan assumed querying a non-existent project returns empty; it errors. Compounded by only two real Cloud projects existing, which cannot faithfully model three repo shapes + empty + unknown paths.

Pivot (user-directed, option A + DC): rework the rehearsal to run against the ephemeral Jira DC instance the existing tests/external/live_jira_dc harness stands up in CI, where we hold admin rights and can create/destroy throwaway projects per run. This makes the rehearsal a reproducible, CI-verified green run in the jira-dc-harness job (not a manual operator-attested Cloud run), dissolves the two-project constraint, models 'empty' with a real empty project, and models 'unknown' as its true fail-closed behaviour. Description + file_impact + ACs rewritten accordingly; the ACs now require a green DC run. Re-running plan-review next.
